lead: Bruce Willis is an American television actor, born on 19 March 1955 in Idar-Oberstein.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.

He is associated with work such as Die Hard, Pulp Fiction and The Fifth Element and has been recognised with Commandeur des Arts et des Lettres‎ and Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Television Series Musical or Comedy.
This profile collects the Bruce facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Bruce Willis — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Bruce Willis was born on 19 March 1955 in Idar-Oberstein, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Walter Bruce Willis at birth and is publicly known as Bruce Willis.
He is a sibling of Dave Willis.
He received his education at Montclair State University and Penns Grove High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Bruce Willis — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists television actor, film actor, voice actor, executive producer and film producer as his occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Bruce are Die Hard, Pulp Fiction, The Fifth Element, Armageddon, The Sixth Sense and Moonlighting.
He performs on voice and harmonica.
